name: What is the National Green Building Standard (NGBS)?

mainEntity.name: What is the National Green Building Standard (NGBS)?

acceptedAnswer.text: NGBS certifies homes for lot design, resource efficiency, water/energy savings, indoor air quality, and operations through independent verification and two required inspections. nahb​
